courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 河床固床工設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「河岸剪力的尺度」與「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河床固床工設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scales of bank shear" and "Mat overlap and effective coverage" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Riverbed grade-control structures must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸；河床固床工設計則以由河床縱坡、能量耗散與泥砂連續性設計固床工為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring; Riverbed grade-control structures centres on designing grade control through bed slope, energy dissipation and sediment continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「河岸剪力的尺度」與「落差配置與縱坡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河床固床工設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「濾層粒徑的相容比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Scales of bank shear” and “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Riverbed grade-control structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Filter grading compatibility", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 魚道水理設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「河岸剪力的尺度」與「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；魚道水理設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scales of bank shear" and "Mat overlap and effective coverage" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Hydraulic design of fish passages must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸；魚道水理設計則以依魚種生命期解析通道水理、入口誘導與通過證據為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring; Hydraulic design of fish passages centres on relating passage hydraulics and attraction to species, life stage and passage evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「河岸剪力的尺度」與「池間落差與射流」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到魚道水理設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「篩網接近速度比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Scales of bank shear” and “Pool drops and jet velocity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Hydraulic design of fish passages, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Screen approach velocity comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 河岸生態護岸
history.text: 美國自然資源保育署二〇〇七年河岸土壤生物工程補編，將河趾、岸坡與洪氾平原的處理方式分開討論，並收錄佛蒙特州威努斯基河背景。二〇二〇年國家層級護岸標準目錄另提醒實作須依地方文件。雷赫河一九九八年啟動的復育計畫則提供河川動態與棲地共存的尺度參照。本課不聲稱這些案例採用相同工法，所有荷載及材料數字均為獨立教材假設。
history.textEn: The 2007 NRCS soil bioengineering supplement distinguishes treatments at the toe, bank and floodplain and includes Winooski River context in Vermont. The 2020 national bank protection directory directs actual application to local documents. The Regge programme launched in 1998 offers a broader example of accommodating river dynamics and habitat. These references do not imply identical construction methods. All loads and material quantities in the exercises are independently chosen teaching assumptions.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「河岸剪力的尺度」到「對照監測的生態成效」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Scales of bank shear" through "Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
